tracks.title: 九降風的菜脯 Káu-kàng-hong ê Tshài-póo
tracks.mood: hazy, tender and windswept, a long dry winter on a rooftop
tracks.subject: a granddaughter spending one dry, windy Hsinchu winter on the rooftop with her living grandmother making sun-dried radish (菜脯): weeks of salting, turning the radish morning and night on bamboo trays in the northeast 'nine-descending' wind, while the grandmother talks about working the salt pans and the salty radish grandpa brought when he first came courting
